_doc: Agent file-share markup, consumed by the iOS (OrbFileRefTests) and Android (OrbFileRefsTest) parsers. Desktop parity: orb/src/richTags.ts. Samples are real assistant_message markup from prod mission_events (tag syntax kept verbatim; labels of client engagements neutralised because this repository is public). Each case: input text, expected refs (type, path, label, mime?) and the prose left once tags are removed (`text`, whitespace-collapsed). Hermes `MEDIA:<path>` lines (its chat-attachment directive) read as the equivalent tag: an image extension gives an image ref, anything else a file ref. Core rewrites them at ingestion (src/api/cloud_agents/media.rs runs these cases too); the client fallback covers older messages and accepts a directive only alone on its line, outside code. `unavailable` marks a share Core could not copy, shown as a "file no longer available" chip.
